g.text: DeepSeek-V4: CSA's compressor (m = 4), HCA's (m' = 128), and the V4-Flash layer stack
CSA: entry i pools block i and block i-1
solid: 'a' stream from the current block; dashed: 'b' stream from the previous block.
per-channel softmax over all 8 inputs, plus a learned per-position bias.
entries overlap by one block, so one entry per 4 tokens.
HCA: 128 tokens into one entry, no overlap
1M tokens -> 8,192 entries, few enough to attend densely:
V4-Flash: 43 layers, every one with a 128-token window
green: CSA ratio 4 with indexer (21 layers)
